up: Return the exact activity values and compound structures for all compounds tested in assay CHEMBL4649944. Include the standard relation, standard value, standard units, standard type, and canonical SMILES for each compound.
sql: SELECT activities.standard_relation, activities.standard_value, activities.standard_units, activities.standard_type, compound_structures.canonical_smiles FROM activities JOIN compound_structures ON activities.molregno = compound_structures.molregno JOIN assays ON activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id WHERE assays.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4649944';
